Identity.Name: Pset_StingCostManagement
Identity.Definition: STING cost management and BOQ parameters — NRM2 rates, embodied carbon tracking, labour, and procurement metadata. Written by BOQPrepForExportCommand, BOQCostManager, and CostStamp.

Governance.StandardsBasis: RICS NRM2 (2nd ed.); ICE Database v3; BS ISO 15686-5 whole-life costing; ICMS 3rd edition

Property.name: CST_RATE_GBP
Property.Definition: Unit rate (GBP) from the active rate book — BCIS, project rate card, or manual override.

Property.name: CST_TOTAL_GBP
Property.Definition: Total elemental cost (GBP) = unit rate × measured quantity.

Property.name: CST_NRM2_REF_TXT
Property.Definition: NRM2 work section reference (e.g. 5.4.1.1) identifying the measurement rule.

Property.name: CST_NRM2_PARAGRAPH_TXT
Property.Definition: NRM2 natural-language paragraph description generated by BOQParagraphEnhancer for schedule-of-works output.

Property.name: CST_RATE_SOURCE_TXT
Property.Definition: Rate provenance identifier: BCIS / ProjectCard / MaterialLibrary / Manual / Override.

Property.name: CST_CARBON_KG_CO2E
Property.Definition: Embodied carbon (kg CO2e) per ICE Database v3 or project EPD for this element.

Property.name: CST_CARBON_SOURCE_TXT
Property.Definition: Carbon data provenance: ICE_v3 / EPD / Estimate.

Property.name: CST_BOQ_ITEM_TXT
Property.Definition: BOQ line-item description for the schedule of works or tender document.

Property.name: CST_BOQ_UNIT_TXT
Property.Definition: BOQ measurement unit per NRM2: nr / m / m2 / m3 / kg / t / item.

Property.name: CST_BOQ_QUANTITY
Property.Definition: BOQ measured quantity in the declared unit.

Property.name: CST_PROVISIONAL_SUM_BOOL
Property.Definition: True when this item is carried as a provisional sum rather than a measured quantity.

Property.name: CST_LABOUR_HOURS
Property.Definition: Estimated installation labour hours from STING_LABOUR_RATES.csv.

Property.name: CST_LABOUR_TRADE_TXT
Property.Definition: Trade code for labour allocation: MEP / ELEC / CARP / PAINT / PLUMB / STRUCT.

Property.name: CST_SNAPSHOT_REF_TXT
Property.Definition: BOQ snapshot reference used for delta and comparison reporting by BoqSyncCoordinator.
